# Kuipra Communications

> Kuipra Communications is a social media marketing agency based in Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada. The agency specializes in social media management, event marketing and amplification, influencer campaigns, content creation, local SEO & AI search optimization (GEO), and brand strategy for businesses across Greater Vancouver and BC — including bilingual (English / Traditional Chinese) campaigns for the Chinese-Canadian market.

Key facts:
- Location: Vancouver, BC, Canada
- Services: social media management, event marketing, influencer marketing, content creation, PR, personal branding, brand strategy
- Languages: English and Traditional Chinese (bilingual campaigns)
- Contact: info@kuipra.ca
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/kuipra_communications/

## Services

- [Social Media Management](https://www.kuipra.ca/services/social-media-management/): bilingual social media management across Instagram, TikTok, Xiaohongshu and WeChat
- [Content Creation](https://www.kuipra.ca/services/content-creation/): copy, visuals and short-form video
- [Brand Strategy & Personal Branding](https://www.kuipra.ca/services/brand-strategy/): positioning, messaging and founder brands
- [Local SEO & AI Search Optimization (GEO)](https://www.kuipra.ca/services/local-seo-geo/): Google Maps ranking, local search and getting recommended by AI assistants
- [Bilingual & Chinese-Market Marketing](https://www.kuipra.ca/services/chinese-marketing/): native Xiaohongshu, WeChat and bilingual EN/ZH campaigns for the Chinese-speaking market
- [Web Design & Development](https://www.kuipra.ca/services/web-design/): SEO- and AI-search-ready bilingual websites
- [服務總覽（中文）](https://www.kuipra.ca/zh/services/)
